row: In the 1960s, a healer embarked on a spiritual journey by practicing yoga and seeking divine guidance. He prayed for guidance to help others overcome physical ailments. The healer learned how to invoke divine forces and natural elements for personal and collective healing. Breath control is crucial in yoga, as it opens the body and allows for energy circulation. He shares his healing methods, including using natural oils and plants to create healing mixtures. He emphasizes the effectiveness of energy healing and the significance of rituals in achieving balance and health. He believes that by calling upon both earthly and divine elements, one can manifest healing. The healer's legacy and continued practice are reflected in his travels, teachings from ancestors, and the establishment of healing places. He encourages others to follow his path towards spiritual healing and environmental balance.
